title: Early Production Results for Blend’s Autopilot Show What Agentic AI Means For Lending
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, August 20, 2026--Blend (NYSE: BLND) today shared early production results for Autopilot, its agentic system for lending, showing a marked increase in pull-through rates and a reduction in loan-cycle times. Since March 2026, Autopilot's pre-underwriting agent has processed more than 50,000 live production loans across lenders on Blend's Home Lending platform.
